rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a series of things or events.

example.english: A succession of strange events happened this morning.
example.traditional: 今朝發生咗一連串古怪事件。
example.jyutping: gam1 ziu1 faat3 sang1 zo2 jat1 lin4 cyun3 gu2 gwaai3 si6 gin6

rows.note: Use this when the focus is on which thing follows which in sequence.

example.english: We need to agree on the succession of speakers first.
example.traditional: 我哋要先講清楚發言嘅先後次序。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sin1 gong2 cing1 co2 faat3 jin4 ge3 sin1 hau6 ci3 zeoi6

rows.note: Use this specifically for the passing of royal power to a successor.

example.english: The succession to the throne in this country was peaceful.
example.traditional: 呢個國家嘅王位繼承過程好和平。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 wong4 wai6 gai3 sing4 gwo3 cing4 hou2 wo4 ping4
